info.description: REST API extension for Burp Suite Professional that enables programmatic access to proxy traffic, scanner functionality, scope management, and collaborative testing workflows. Features advanced response analysis, real-time proxy interception, and enhanced security testing capabilities using Montoya API 2025.8+.

post.description: Replay requests by proxy_traffic.id (the public id space returned by /proxy/search, /proxy/history and /proxy/send). Unresolved ids are reported under 'not_found' rather than silently dropped. Optionally assert intent with 'expect' ({method?, url?}) top-level or per-id ({id, expect}); an id whose resolved row does not match is reported under 'mismatched' and not replayed. See issue #28. (requires: request_ids)

schema.description: { request_ids: [id | {id, expect:{method?,url?}}], expect?: {method?,url?}, session_tag?, cookie_jar? }. Use a proxy_traffic.id; /proxy/search/request-body returns it as 'id' when 'replayable' is true.

200.description: Replayed. May include 'not_found' (unresolved ids) and 'mismatched' (ids that failed an 'expect' assertion).

404.description: No supplied id resolved to a proxy_traffic record ('not_found' lists them)

409.description: No id both resolved and matched its 'expect' assertion; nothing was replayed ('mismatched' lists them)

get.description: Generate a curl command for a captured request (optional: redact, pretty, shell, metadata). The id is the public proxy_traffic.id returned by /proxy/search and /proxy/history; an internal traffic_meta id (the 'traffic_meta_id' from /proxy/search/request-body or annotation contexts) is also accepted and resolved through its proxy_traffic_id link, so a hit does not have to be reconstructed by hand. The response echoes 'request_id' (the public id the curl was built from), 'requested_id' (the id you passed), and 'resolved_via' ('id' when they match, 'traffic_meta_id' when the internal id was followed). A 404 means the id names no captured request in either id space (#22).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Public proxy_traffic id (as returned by /proxy/search and /proxy/history), or an internal traffic_meta id with a linked capture

request_id.description: Public proxy_traffic.id the curl was built from; reuse it for /proxy/replay

requested_id.description: The id supplied in the path

resolved_via.description: 'id' when the path id was already the public id, 'traffic_meta_id' when an internal id was followed to its linked capture

404.description: No captured request resolves to the id in either the public proxy_traffic space or as a linked internal traffic_meta id

get.summary: Generate curl command for request (requires: id; optional: redact, pretty, shell, metadata)

get.description: Byte-exact raw request/response bytes for a stored row (#24). The flattened headers/body columns are a lossy search projection; this serves the exact wire bytes, base64-encoded, so a client decode reproduces what Burp sent/received. A row over max_raw_bytes is omitted (not truncated); a pre-v12 or reconstructed-string row reports present:false with a note.

request_raw_b64.description: Base64 of the exact request wire bytes, or null when absent/omitted

response_raw_b64.description: Base64 of the exact response wire bytes, or null when absent/omitted

request_raw_omitted.description: True when the request exceeded max_raw_bytes and was omitted rather than truncated

response_raw_omitted.description: True when the response exceeded max_raw_bytes and was omitted rather than truncated

note.description: Present only when neither side has raw bytes, explaining why

404.description: No traffic record with that ID

get.summary: Byte-exact raw request/response bytes for a stored row (base64)

get.description: Search burp2api's own captured-traffic store (not Burp's live proxy history). Pre-existing browser/proxy history is not searchable until imported once via POST /proxy/import-history. Filters: url, match, method, host, hosts[], status_code, session_tag, tags, has_tags, has_comments, comment, case_insensitive, start_time, end_time, since, limit, offset. The 'url' filter is a substring match by default; pass match=exact to pin one full URL exactly, or use * and ? wildcards in 'url' for anchored LIKE matching. To locate one specific captured request reliably, tag it (session_tag on send/replay, or POST /proxy/tag) and filter by session_tag rather than by a path substring. The response is always a JSON object with a 'results' array (never a bare array and never an 'items' key); 'pagination' is present only when 'limit' or 'offset' is supplied. Each record includes request_http_version and response_http_version.

count.description: Number of results on this page (results.length)

pagination.description: Present only when 'limit' or 'offset' is supplied

body.description: Request body. UTF-8 text (control characters escaped) when body_encoding is 'utf-8'; Base64 when body_encoding is 'base64'.

body_encoding.description: Discriminator for 'body': 'utf-8' text or 'base64' for binary/non-UTF-8 bodies.

body_truncated.description: True when the request body hit the storage ceiling (max_stored_content_chars) and was trimmed. The store never writes a marker into captured content, so this flag is the only signal.

headers_list.description: Structured request headers, ordered, duplicates preserved.

max_stored_content_chars.description: Per-column storage ceiling in characters, from BURP2API_MAX_STORED_CONTENT_CHARS. Content below it is stored verbatim.

response_body.description: Captured response body. UTF-8 text (control characters escaped) when response_body_encoding is 'utf-8'; Base64 when response_body_encoding is 'base64'.

response_body_encoding.description: Discriminator for 'response_body': 'utf-8' text or 'base64' for binary/non-UTF-8 bodies.

response_body_truncated.description: True when the response body hit the storage ceiling (max_stored_content_chars) and was trimmed.

response_headers_list.description: Structured response headers, ordered, duplicates (e.g. Set-Cookie) preserved.

total_count.description: Total matching rows across all pages

get.summary: Search captured traffic (run POST /proxy/import-history first for pre-existing browser history). Returns an object with a 'results' array; 'pagination' only when limit/offset is set.

get.description: FTS5-powered full-text search in request bodies (requires: q query parameter). Each hit's 'id' is the public, replayable proxy_traffic.id (resolved via the exact proxy_traffic_id link recorded at capture time, schema v14 — not a content_hash guess, so a request captured more than once resolves to the exact instance), 'traffic_meta_id' is the internal id (do not replay with it), and 'replayable' is false when the hit has no linked proxy_traffic counterpart (then 'id' is null; reconstruct via /proxy/send). See issue #28.
get.summary: FTS5-powered full-text search in request bodies (requires: q query parameter)

get.description: FTS5-powered full-text search in response bodies (requires: q query parameter). Symmetric to /proxy/search/request-body: it matches the trigger-maintained response_index (response headers + body) that previously had no endpoint, so response-body search silently returned nothing (issue #12). Each hit's 'id' is the public, replayable proxy_traffic.id (resolved via the exact proxy_traffic_id link recorded at capture time, schema v14), 'traffic_meta_id' is the internal id (do not replay with it), and 'replayable' is false when the hit has no linked proxy_traffic counterpart (then 'id' is null; reconstruct via /proxy/send).
get.summary: FTS5-powered full-text search in response bodies (requires: q query parameter)

post.description: Send HTTP request and capture response (requires: method, url; optional: headers as a JSON object, an array of [name, value] pairs, or newline-separated 'Name: Value' lines, body, session_tag). Set cookie_jar to 'use' (apply and update a session_tag-scoped cookie jar), 'reset' (clear it first, then use), or 'off' (default, stateless) for stateful flows like OIDC/Clerk logins where cookies rotate across calls. Set follow_redirects=true (with optional max_redirects, default 5, max 10) to follow 3xx Location chains carrying the jar each hop.

body.description: Response body. UTF-8 text (control characters escaped) when body_encoding is 'utf-8'; Base64-encoded bytes when body_encoding is 'base64' (binary/non-UTF-8).

body_encoding.description: Discriminator for 'body': 'utf-8' text or 'base64' for binary/non-UTF-8 bodies.

headers_list.description: Structured response headers, ordered, duplicates (e.g. Set-Cookie) preserved. Built from the live response, so byte-exact.

post.summary: Send HTTP request and capture response (requires: method, url; optional: headers as a JSON object, an array of [name, value] pairs, or newline-separated 'Name: Value' lines, body, session_tag). post.description: Scan raw HTTP request (requires: method, url; optional: headers, body, audit_config, session_tag). Ticket #13: scope preflight (auto_scope) plus an optional Burp built-in REST API backend for named scan_configurations and a resource_pool the Montoya API cannot set.

auto_scope.description: Default true: add the target to Burp scope if missing (an out-of-scope audit is silently accepted but sends zero payload variations). false rejects an out-of-scope target with HTTP 409.

backend.description: auto (default) prefers Burp's built-in REST API with the default audit config (BURP2API_SCAN_CONFIG=b2a-light-fuzz) + resource pool, and falls back to a Montoya audit when REST is unreachable or the request is non-GET/has a body (REST scans by URL and can't replay a body). montoya forces an exact-request Montoya audit; rest forces REST. Extension checks (param-fuzzer) run on either backend when the audit config includes them.

headers.description: Request headers. Accepts a JSON object {"Name": "Value"}, an array of [name, value] pairs, or a legacy CRLF 'Name: Value' string. Duplicate names are last-wins.

resource_pool.description: REST backend only. Omitted -> BURP2API_RESOURCE_POOL (default "Default resource pool", preset to 1 concurrent / 1000ms by the project template). Send "" to run without a named pool. The Montoya fallback path is throttled by the same project pool (POST /scope/project-config).

scan_configurations.description: REST backend only. Omitted -> BURP2API_SCAN_CONFIG (default b2a-light-fuzz, which keeps param-fuzzer). Explicit [] -> Burp's default config. NOTE: the built-in "Audit checks - light/medium active" presets EXCLUDE extension-registered checks (param-fuzzer); b2a-light-fuzz and the default config include them.

409.description: Out of scope with auto_scope=false — scan would send zero payload variations

post.summary: Scan raw HTTP request (requires: method, url; optional: headers, body, audit_config, session_tag). Ticket #13: scope preflight (auto_scope) plus an optional Burp built-in REST API backend for named scan_configurations and a resource_pool the Montoya API cannot set.
